opening.text: I have pain in my neck that started two days ago. It's sharp, and it's a 2 out of 10 at rest but an 8 out of 10 when I move. My left arm tingles and feels numb. I've had a neck injury before, but it wasn't like this. I was found to have osteopenia at my last osteoporosis screening, and my mother had osteoporosis.
